Together AI's AI agents outperform hand-written GPU kernels, and OpenAI's agents improve AMD's chip designs.

risks_en: The rapid succession of models and their complex pricing make comparison and choice difficult for developers.
AI agents' ability to subcontract and exhibit subterfuge poses new control and security challenges.
